nodes.text:
The Rise of MHPV Virus Globally 🦠🌍
MHPV (Human Metapneumovirus) is a respiratory virus causing flu-like symptoms such as cough, fever, nasal congestion, and fatigue. It spreads through respiratory droplets or contact with contaminated surfaces. 🦠

nodes.author: RituNegiNagpal
nodes.text:
Global Spread & China Update
Recently, a surge in MHPV cases has been reported in China, where it has been linked to 6.2% of respiratory illness tests and 5.4% of hospitalizations due to respiratory infections.

nodes.author: RituNegiNagpal
nodes.text: India tally reaches 3, Karnataka with 2 and Gujarat confirms 1.

nodes.author: RituNegiNagpal
nodes.text:
Why It Matters 
MHPV typically spreads during winter and spring, overlapping with flu and RSV outbreaks. This can lead to:
Co-infections, worsening symptoms and outcomes
Difficulty in diagnosing and distinguishing from other respiratory viruses

nodes.author: RituNegiNagpal
nodes.text:
Precautions- Avoiding close contact with sick individuals and Stay home if unwell
Symptoms-Runny nose, Cough, Sore throat, Fever,  Congestion
There is no vaccine or specific treatment yet

nodes.author: RituNegiNagpal
nodes.text:
Stay updated, stay safe! 🌟 Let’s work together to minimize the impact of MHPV.
